entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Regression in ExecuteUpdate with lambda-based SetProperty of constant value #38013
  • Checking equality of values with convertible types makes query precompilation fail #38012
  • ExecuteUpdateAsync throws SQLite Error 1: 'no such column: ...' when working with navigation properties in EFCore Sqlite #38010
  • Missing using directive in generated precompiled query source file #38009
    Backlog
  • Regression between v9 and v10: System.InvalidCastException when query parameter is IEnumerable #38008

Closed

  • Set optional complex property to null, does not set inner properties value-type with default value inner properties to null #37890
    10.0.6
  • Cosmos: Manual session token management, eventual consistency on reload after pre condition failure #37942
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • (11.0 main) CFSClean2 network isolation policy update #38018
  • [release/10.0] Add CFSClean2 to network isolation policy #38017
    tell-mode
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38016
  • Restore sqlite3mc test project using SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle #38015
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38014
  • [release/10.0] Fix SetProperty discard lambda failing for nullable value type properties in ExecuteUpdate #38007
  • Remove file-based seeding for Cosmos DB functional tests #38005
    community-contribution
  • Split Helix into separate AzDO jobs per queue, enable verbose xunit, configurable timeout #38003

Merged

  • Show a warning when the PMC tools are used with a platform-specific app #38000
  • Add issue-closed workflow and switch runners to ubuntu-slim #38006
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #37907
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37986
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38011
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38004
  • Cosmos: Track session tokens for Pre-Condition, Conflict and document NotFound failures #37941
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38002

Updated

  • Fix run value converters that convert nulls for JSON columns #37984
    community-contribution
  • Add dotnet-ef JSON config defaults and validation features #37966
    community-contribution
  • Auto-start Cosmos emulator via Testcontainers #37999
